observations.behavior: Adds a new Prometheus metric, CAPTURE_TIMESTAMP_PATH_TOTAL, to record the source of the stored timestamp.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog to distinguish between different timestamp sources, which could help with debugging and understanding the behavior of the system.

observations.behavior: Adds a new Prometheus metric, CAPTURE_STORED_VS_CLIENT_CAPTURE_SECONDS, to record the difference between the stored timestamp and the client capture timestamp.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog to understand the relationship between the stored timestamp and the client capture timestamp, which could help with debugging and understanding the behavior of the system.

observations.behavior: Adds a new Prometheus metric, CAPTURE_EDGE_TO_NOW_SECONDS, to record the time from an upstream hop stamping the request to capture reading its clock.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog to understand the relationship between the stored timestamp and the client capture timestamp, which could help with debugging and understanding the behavior of the system.
